No checks passed, meaning the model correctly identified that the hidden facts were not present, but the scenario itself provides no mechanism to force the model to seek or require the hidden information to reach a correct settlement.

fix_instructions: The scenario currently lacks any tension where the initial public facts (S3) lead to incorrect decisions. To make this a multi-agent scenario, ensure that the public facts alone are insufficient or lead to an error if the hidden facts (PF1, PF2, PF3) are not integrated via conversation. Specifically, tighten C1, C2, C6 (dependent on PF1), C3, C7, P1 (dependent on PF2), and C4, C5, C8 (dependent on PF3) so they cannot be satisfied by the default values seen in the rollouts.
